name: test-audit
description: Decide whether a test earns its place: an authoring gate for new tests (what it protects, which regression fails it, why coverage misses it, no test-only seams, regression tests proven red before the fix), low-value patterns, a retention bar and an evidence ledger before deletes. Use when writing or reviewing tests, when asked for a regression test, or when auditing a suite for junk tests or test-only production code. Ships a pytest smell scanner and a test-only-symbol finder.
